plugins.description: Where your direct debits fail and the manual work it causes, counted from your own bank files: failed collections by bank reason code and the failure rate per collection day. Add your mandate list and invoice export for the 36-month mandate rule, unmatched payments and payment terms against reality. Then this month's work, prepared: new attempts, customer mail drafts, mandates to renew and match suggestions. Drafts only, nothing is sent. Twikey receives nothing.
